findings.problem: quick-alternative is disabled on `blocked() || !runs.run()`, while the test contract says disabled iff ... or `RunStore.run()?.status !== 'COMPLETED'`. It works today only because app-quick-actions is rendered inside the COMPLETED result view; the backend would answer 409 RUN_NOT_COMPLETED otherwise.
findings.fix: Use `blocked() || runs.run()?.status !== 'COMPLETED'` in the template and in alternative().

findings.problem: AvoidedFutures.load selection is only exercised for n = 1 and 2 (IT #1, #3). The spec's range classes n = 10 and n = 11 (parent as Future 1 plus the 9 newest others, oldest other dropped, still oldest first) are not covered. ScenarioGenerationPromptTest only checks the prompt-side cut of a pre-built list of 11.
findings.fix: Add an IT that seeds 11 COMPLETED runs on the same pack (jdbc seed, as RecentRunsIT) and asserts the futures-to-avoid order and that the oldest non-parent run is the one dropped.
